name: palette
title: Palette
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: A visual color palette editor with a 2D HSV picker, sortable swatch grid, color naming, and one-click export to hex arrays, CSS custom properties, Tailwind config, or HSL strings.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/palette. Drop PaletteRoot anywhere for the full editor, or compose with PaletteGrid, PaletteToolbar, and PaletteColorEditor manually. Use usePalette for programmatic control inside any child component.
